cases.title: DeltaTable.merge with whenMatchedUpdate and whenNotMatchedInsert
cases.code:
spark.createDataFrame([(2, 'B', 25.0), (3, 'C', 35.0), (4, 'd', 40.0)], 'id INT, name STRING, amount DOUBLE').createOrReplaceTempView('upd')
from delta.tables import DeltaTable
result = (DeltaTable.forName(spark, 'sales').alias('t').merge(spark.table('upd').alias('s'), 't.id = s.id')
    .whenMatchedUpdate(set={'amount': 't.amount + s.amount'})
    .whenNotMatchedInsert(values={'id': 's.id', 'name': 's.name', 'amount': 's.amount'})
    .execute())

cases.title: DeltaTable.merge with Column conditions and values
cases.code:
spark.createDataFrame([(1, 'A', 11.0, True), (2, 'B', 25.0, False), (4, 'd', 40.0, False), (5, 'e', 50.0, True)], 'id INT, name STRING, amount DOUBLE, gone BOOLEAN').createOrReplaceTempView('upd')
from delta.tables import DeltaTable
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
result = (DeltaTable.forName(spark, 'sales').alias('t').merge(spark.table('upd').alias('s'), F.col('t.id') == F.col('s.id'))
    .whenMatchedDelete(condition=F.col('s.gone'))
    .whenMatchedUpdate(set={'amount': F.col('s.amount') * 2})
    .whenNotMatchedInsert(condition=~F.col('s.gone'), values={'id': F.col('s.id'), 'amount': F.lit(0.0)})
    .execute())
